migration_family: RSA encryption and key wrapping redesign
migration_objective: Replace RSA-wrapped per-document data keys with a protocol using ML-KEM to establish a wrapping secret, a KDF, and authenticated symmetric wrapping.
preconditions: No production data or credentials are present.
expected_behavior: Preserve the document import and retrieval contract.
Reject invalid cryptographic inputs without exposing secret material.
migration_requirements: Use standardized algorithms through a maintained cryptographic provider.
Update key serialization and every dependent application call.
Do not treat ML-KEM as direct arbitrary RSA encryption.
verification_procedure: Generate new keys using the declared PQC provider.
Run positive and tamper-rejection cases relevant to this operation.
Record provider/version and machine-readable test output.
known_limitations: No PQC reference migration has been implemented or verified.
The available runtime provider version lacks the required ML-DSA/ML-KEM API.
